title: Drafter-A pair
description: One drafter-training sample: (task_desc/slots, body). Silver pairs = pipeline_runs.filled_text (548, SFT warmup only, never reward positive). Gold pairs = human-verified compliant body. Slot consistency enforced by the exporter validator: all {{slot}} placeholders in body must be replaced, and replaced keys ⊆ declared slots.

slots.description: Declared slot values the drafter must fill into the body. May be empty for a fully-drafted body with no declared slots (slot-consistency still enforced: body must contain no unreplaced {{slot}}).

body.description: Filled contract body. No unreplaced {{slot}} placeholders (validator-enforced).

contract_type.description: Contract class key of the source run (e.g. sale, employment). Null for rows whose source predates type tagging.

scenario.description: Business scenario tag (业务场景, e.g. 农产品买卖). Null when the source run carried no tags.

stance.description: Drafting stance (pro_a | pro_b | balanced). Null when the source run carried no tags. Coverage is heavily skewed toward balanced.

tier.description: silver = LLM draft (SFT warmup only); gold = human-verified compliant body.
